caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing upright, facing forward. The figure is wearing a voluminous dress with multiple layers and ruffles. The upper part of the dress is adorned with curly, textured elements in shades of brown and beige, and features blue and red decorative bands crossing the chest and shoulders. The main body of the dress has horizontal sections, with the top section being brownish-gold, followed by two large, ruffled sections in shades of pink and purple, each edged with black trim. The figure’s feet are visible and pointed slightly outward. The figure’s head is oval-shaped with minimal facial features, and the hair is depicted in black, pulled back and tied with a large red ribbon or accessory on the side. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the edges of the paper are slightly yellowed. The drawing is rendered with colored pencils or similar media, producing a textured appearance.
